name: Chilled Seafood Medley: Shrimp, Smoked Salmon Tartare & Bay Scallops ('Til We Meet Again)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Disney Magic · 'Til We Meet Again Menu
whyItWorks: Trio of lean marine proteins with zero plant fiber; only the lemon marinade on the shrimp needs swapping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for plain poached shrimp alongside the smoked salmon tartare and bay scallops (no lemon dressing).
watchOuts: Lemon marinade on the shrimp portion if not ordered plain
